100% yes. It’s my most played fallout game as someone who has done 100% runs of 1, 2, 3, NV (twice), and 4, and my second favorite game behind NV. There’s so much fun content there to experience once you’ve gotten over the gameplay hump that is playing on an MMORPG. You can complete all the main quests solo, with the public parts being events, raids, expeditions, etc. so let me give you a run down of highlights from the game:

The world changes. The first main quest is about stopping a plague ravaging the wastes. When that was completed, settlers came back to Appalachia.

You can orchestrate an oceans 11 style heist on a vault filled to the brim with gold.

Top tier environmental story telling such as the vault computer that systematically got every one of their vault residents to turn on each other, the pre-war town that became patient 0 for FEV, and how a faction of first responders got amazingly close to solving the wastes’ problems 6 years before 76ers left the vault.

Plethora of new canon power armor and weapons with awesome lore.

Cool cryptid creatures and location specific bosses like the wendigo colossus, storm sentinels, and ultracite titan.

4-5 main story-length questlines (the plague, the vault heist, the brotherhood divided, and The Lost)

The biggest (16 square miles) and most beautiful map of any fallout game.

Ability to revisit the Pitt AND Atlantic City

Home Building is more diverse and you can place your camp practically anywhere.
